name: Senado de la República
notes: 50 seats. The Senate's own site (senado.cl) is behind a Cloudflare check and its web service lists only the 2022 cohort, so who sits and their party are from the Spanish Wikipedia list of current senators, a secondary source kept by editors; a seat left empty (a senator removed from office) shows as Vacant. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
